name: Chiang Rai city retail and airport band
notes: Primary urban catchment joining Central, hospitals, airport approach, Ban Du growth, and repeat city trips suited to destination charging.

name: Wiang Pa Pao Route 118 gateway service town
notes: Key intercity stop between Chiang Mai and Chiang Rai where food, fuel, market, and service demand should support corridor fast charging better than pure pass-through cells.

name: Mae Suai Route 118 service town
notes: Mid-corridor district service cluster on Route 118 that helps keep the Chiang Mai-Chiang Rai spine from relying only on one stopover node.

name: Phan Route 1 service town
notes: Southbound district center on Route 1 with hospital, market, and roadside commerce that should read as more than simple through-traffic.

name: Mae Chan north service and retail band
notes: Commercial district hub before Mae Sai and Doi Tung with hospital, Lotus's, and roadside service demand that supports repeat-use charging.

name: Mae Sai border commerce and gateway band
notes: Border-town retail, bus, market, and checkpoint activity with stronger dwell-time potential than an ordinary highway stop.

name: Chiang Saen and Golden Triangle service band
notes: Tourism and border-service catchment where Chiang Saen town, Hall of Opium, and Golden Triangle activity should hold some destination charging weight.

name: Chiang Khong bridge and logistics service town
notes: Friendship bridge approach, logistics movement, and border-town services combine into a more credible charging node than a pure low-density corridor cell.
